``` {r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
bonafide_predictions <- read_csv("bonafide_predictions.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```


```{r}
df_raw <- read.csv("bonafide_predictions.csv", check.names = FALSE)
table(df_raw$`Race Winner Accuracy`, useNA = "ifany")
unique(df_raw$`Race Winner Accuracy`)
sum(is.na(df_raw$`Race Winner Accuracy`))
df <- df_raw %>%
  mutate(across(matches("Accuracy", ignore.case = TRUE),
                ~ {
                  x <- trimws(tolower(as.character(.)))
                  case_when(
                    str_detect(x, "^yes\\b") ~ 1,
                    str_detect(x, "^no\\b")  ~ 0,
                    x %in% c("1", "true", "t", "y") ~ 1,
                    x %in% c("0", "false", "f", "n") ~ 0,
                    TRUE ~ NA_real_
                  )
                }))
acc <- df %>% select(matches("Accuracy", ignore.case = TRUE))
unique(unlist(acc))
sum(!is.na(unlist(acc)))
table(df$`Race Winner Accuracy`, useNA="ifany")
```
```{r}
df_raw <- read.csv("bonafide_predictions.csv", check.names = FALSE)

df <- df_raw %>%
  mutate(across(matches("Accuracy", ignore.case = TRUE),
                ~ na_if(trimws(as.character(.)), ""))) %>%   # convert blanks "" to NA
  mutate(across(matches("Accuracy", ignore.case = TRUE),
                ~ {
                  x <- tolower(.)
                  case_when(
                    x == "yes" ~ 1,
                    x == "no"  ~ 0,
                    TRUE ~ NA_real_
                  )
                }))
acc <- df %>% select(matches("Accuracy", ignore.case = TRUE))
sum(!is.na(unlist(acc)))         # should be > 0 (you got 89)
unique(unlist(acc))              # should show 0,1,NA
```

```{r}
overall_accuracy <- mean(unlist(acc), na.rm = TRUE)

ggplot(data.frame(Metric = "Overall Accuracy", Accuracy = overall_accuracy),
       aes(x = Metric, y = Accuracy)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(title = "Overall Prediction Accuracy", x = "", y = "Accuracy Rate") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
accuracy_long <- df %>%
  select(matches("Accuracy", ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Prediction_Type", values_to = "Accuracy") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Accuracy))

accuracy_summary <- accuracy_long %>%
  group_by(Prediction_Type) %>%
  summarise(mean_accuracy = mean(Accuracy),
            n = n(),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(mean_accuracy)

ggplot(accuracy_summary,
       aes(x = reorder(Prediction_Type, mean_accuracy), y = mean_accuracy)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(title = "Accuracy by Prediction Type",
       subtitle = "Dashed line = 50% chance benchmark",
       x = "Prediction Type",
       y = "Mean Accuracy") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
  axis.text.x = element_blank(),
  axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
)
```

```{r}
coverage <- df %>%
  select(matches("Accuracy", ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Prediction_Type", values_to = "Accuracy") %>%
  summarise() %>% {NULL}
# easier:
coverage <- df %>%
  select(matches("Accuracy", ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to="Prediction_Type", values_to="Accuracy") %>%
  group_by(Prediction_Type) %>%
  summarise(n_filled = sum(!is.na(Accuracy)), .groups="drop") %>%
  arrange(n_filled)

ggplot(coverage, aes(x = reorder(Prediction_Type, n_filled), y = n_filled)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "How Often Each Prediction Type Was Used",
       x = "Prediction Type",
       y = "Number of Non-Missing Accuracy Entries") +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
accuracy_ci <- df %>%
  select(matches("Accuracy", ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(),
               names_to = "Prediction_Type",
               values_to = "Accuracy") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Accuracy)) %>%
  group_by(Prediction_Type) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_accuracy = mean(Accuracy),
    n = n(),
    se = sqrt(mean_accuracy * (1 - mean_accuracy) / n),
    lower = pmax(0, mean_accuracy - 1.96 * se),
    upper = pmin(1, mean_accuracy + 1.96 * se),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(mean_accuracy)
accuracy_ci <- accuracy_ci %>%
  mutate(Prediction_Type = Prediction_Type %>%
           str_remove(" Accuracy") %>%
           str_replace_all("Driver", "Drv") %>%
           str_replace_all("Team", "Tm") %>%
           str_replace_all("Second", "2nd") %>%
           str_replace_all("Third", "3rd") %>%
           str_replace_all("Points", "Pts") %>%
           str_replace_all("Podium", "Pod") %>%
           str_replace_all("Finish", "Fin") %>%
           str_replace_all("Non-Teammate", "Non-TM") %>%
           str_replace_all("Teammate", "TM") %>%
           str_squish())
ggplot(accuracy_ci,
       aes(x = reorder(Prediction_Type, mean_accuracy),
           y = mean_accuracy)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), width = 0.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed") +
  coord_flip() +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(title = "Prediction Accuracy by Type (95% CI)",
       subtitle = "Dashed line = 50% (random chance)",
       x = "Prediction Type",
       y = "Mean Accuracy") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
  axis.text.x = element_blank(),
  axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
)
```
```{r}
accuracy_ci <- accuracy_ci %>%
  mutate(significant = lower > 0.5)
ggplot(accuracy_ci,
       aes(x = reorder(Prediction_Type, mean_accuracy),
           y = mean_accuracy,
           color = significant)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), width = 0.2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0("n=", n)),
            hjust = -0.2,
            size = 3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed") +
  coord_flip() +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(title = "Prediction Accuracy by Type (95% CI)",
       subtitle = "Green = Significantly Above Chance",
       x = "Prediction Type",
       y = "Mean Accuracy") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
  axis.text.x = element_blank(),
  axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
)
```







Confidence interval structural display options:
Option 1:
```{r}
ggplot(accuracy_ci,
       aes(x = Prediction_Type,
           y = mean_accuracy)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), width = 0.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed") +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~ Category, scales = "free_y") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
  )
```


Option 2:
```{r}
ggplot(accuracy_ci,
       aes(y = reorder(Prediction_Type, mean_accuracy),
           x = mean_accuracy)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = lower, xend = upper,
                   yend = Prediction_Type),
               size = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(title = "Prediction Accuracy (95% CI)",
       x = "Accuracy",
       y = "") +
  theme_minimal() +
theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7))
```
Option 3:
```{r}
ggplot(accuracy_ci,
       aes(x = 1,
           y = reorder(Prediction_Type, mean_accuracy),
           fill = mean_accuracy)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "red", high = "green") +
  labs(title = "Prediction Accuracy Heatmap",
       x = "",
       y = "",
       fill = "Accuracy") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank())
```

Option 4.2:
```{r}
accuracy_ci <- accuracy_ci %>%
  arrange(mean_accuracy) %>%
  mutate(Prediction_Type = factor(Prediction_Type,
                                  levels = Prediction_Type))
accuracy_ci$Prediction_Type <-
  stringr::str_wrap(as.character(accuracy_ci$Prediction_Type), width = 25)
ggplot(accuracy_ci,
       aes(x = Prediction_Type,
           y = mean_accuracy)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
                width = 0.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed") +
```
